name: PandaLily
lore: Upon entering the bamboo forest, beyond the friendly creatures, beautiful bamboo trees, and calm atmosphere, you might see a presence like no other.
This presence is Lily, the spirit guardian of the bamboo forest.
The name Lily comes from the masters who taught her.
The half-panda, half-girl’s main goal is to protect all creatures that reside within from any harm that might come their way.
One way she ensures this is by having all creatures, no matter who they are, lick any outsiders coming in to ensure no harm comes the forest’s or creatures’ way.
Lily has the ability to travel through realms freely and effortlessly, meaning she holds unbelievable power.
But with the forest being so peaceful for the past hundred years, her guardian duties have been reduced over time.
Without needing to travel to the spirit realm often, she spends a good deal of her time looking for new friends.
But when the forest is in turmoil, Lily is not someone to mess with.
She is a fierce, strong warrior trained by the Ancients, who gave her the green mark on her forehead.
When battle is present, you might see her wield her favorite weapon: the three-sectional staff, crafted by Lily herself.
Aggressors of the forest knew the name Lily well, many keeping it quiet so as not to alert the spirit guardian, as that would guarantee their demise.
